name: simulink-streaming-dsp
description: Building or editing Simulink (.slx) models that stream signals in frames using DSP System Toolbox — audio, vibration, radar, comms. Use when the prompt names a Simulink block (Discrete FIR Filter, Buffer, Unbuffer, Rate Transition, Downsample, Upsample, Sample-Rate Converter, FIR Decimation, Time Scope, Spectrum Analyzer, From Multimedia File) or an action (frame-based processing, InputProcessing, buffering, overlap, windowing, STFT, short-time Fourier, decimate, downsample, upsample, resample, multirate, anti-aliasing, tunable filter). Prevents silent numerical errors from sample-vs-frame mismatch, wrong block choice, or missing anti-aliasing.
